  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Tic Tac Toe</title>
  <style>
    body {
      min-height: 100dvh;
      margin: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      padding: 4vh 1.5rem 4rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      text-align: center;
    }
    h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 2.25rem; line-height: 1.1; }
    .status {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      min-height: 1.5rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    }
    .scoreboard {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .score {
      padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--color-surface, rgba(128,128,128,0.12));
      min-width: 80px;
    }
    .score .label { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--color-text-secondary); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
    .score .value { font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; }
    .board {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 96px);
      grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 96px);
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .cell {
      font-size: 3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--color-surface, rgba(128,128,128,0.12));
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: transform 0.08s ease, background 0.15s ease;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .cell:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(1.05); background: rgba(128,128,128,0.22); }
    .cell:disabled { cursor: default; }
    .cell.x { color: #3b82f6; }
    .cell.o { color: #ef4444; }
    .cell.win { background: rgba(34,197,94,0.35); }
    .controls { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; }
    button.btn {
      padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border, rgba(128,128,128,0.3));
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: inherit;
    }
    button.btn:hover { background: rgba(128,128,128,0.15); }
    button.btn.primary { background: #3b82f6; color: white; border-color: #3b82f6; }
    button.btn.primary:hover { background: #2563eb; }
  </style>

parts.text: build me a completely new tic tac toe game
I'll build you a Tic Tac Toe game. Let me start by scaffolding the app.
Now let me build the actual game. I'll write a complete, self-contained Tic Tac Toe with score tracking.
Let me validate it has no issues, then publish.

Clean pass. Here's your brand-new Tic Tac Toe game.

**Tic Tac Toe** — [open it here](/a/99ca76ac-6630-42f4-8323-5eec39fcb64a)

What you get:
- **Two-player X/O** on a proper 3×3 grid, taking turns
- **Win detection** with the winning line highlighted in green
- **Draw detection** when the board fills up
- **Scoreboard** tracking X wins, O wins, and draws — persisted per user, so it survives a reload
- **New Round** (keeps scores) and **Reset Scores** buttons

It's currently personal-scope. Say the word if you want it published to a team or the whole org — or want an AI opponent so you're not stuck playing yourself like some kind of solitaire enjoyer.

enhancement.description: Two-player X/O on a 3×3 grid with highlighted winning lines, draw detection, and a persistent scoreboard tracking wins and draws.
enhancement.prompt: Build me a two-player tic tac toe game on a 3x3 grid where players take turns as X and O, it highlights the winning line and calls out draws, and keeps a scoreboard of X wins, O wins, and draws that survives a reload, with a button to start a new round and one to reset the scores.
enhancement.response:
Your Tic Tac Toe game is built and ready to play — a clean two-player match on a proper 3×3 grid.

- Two-player X/O with players taking turns on the board
- Win detection that highlights the winning line in green
- Draw detection when the board fills up with no winner
- A scoreboard tracking X wins, O wins, and draws, persisted per user so it survives a reload
- New Round to play again while keeping scores, and Reset Scores to start fresh

Open it [here](/a/99ca76ac-6630-42f4-8323-5eec39fcb64a) and just tap a square to take your turn. It's personal-scope for now — let me know if you'd like it shared with a team or want an AI opponent added.
